# Playwright Full Guide

Use this guide for browser-level test design and reliability.

## Scope

- User journey automation
- Locator strategy and assertions
- Flake reduction and debugging
- CI-ready E2E test suites

## Core Playbook

1. Model real user behavior.
2. Use resilient role-based locators.
3. Assert explicit outcomes.
4. Stabilize async behavior and fixtures.
